meta.description: Every source of CK3 knight effectiveness (knight_effectiveness_mult, knight_effectiveness_per_<skill>) and knight_limit in game/common, with the CK3 trigger that tests it from the knights' liege.
meta.receiver: liege: the ruler whose knights they are = the owner of the army the knight fights in (army_owner of knight_army). Knight effectiveness modifiers on the knight himself do nothing for him (game concept knight_effectiveness, accolade liege_modifier vs knight_modifier).
meta.formula: knight_effectiveness = 1 + sum(mult x instances x scale) + sum(per_skill.value x liege skill x instances). CK3: at 100% knights fight normally, at 200% as if their prowess were doubled (game_concept_knight_effectiveness_desc).
meta.trigger_context: Every trigger/count is written for the liege as the current scope (this). Some use saved scopes the caller sets first: scope:ck3xbl_kl = the liege (artifacts, holy sites), scope:holder = the liege (building is_enabled), scope:councillor_liege = the liege (council task scale, evaluated in the councillor scope).

fields.subkind: finer class (static_character_modifier, artifact_modifier, holding_building, domicile_building, court_position_employer, holy_site_faith_scaled, council_task, accolade_liege_modifier, ...)
fields.scope_owner: who must hold the source: liege | liege_culture | liege_rite | liege_faith | liege_dynasty | liege_held_holding | liege_domicile | liege_court | liege_court_position_employee | liege_as_court_position_holder | liege_councillor | liege_active_accolade | liege_house_bloc | liege_equipped_artifact | liege_holds_holy_site_county | knight | army | courtiers
fields.mult: knight_effectiveness_mult (0.1 = +10 %), null if the block has none
fields.per_skill: [{skill, value}]: knight_effectiveness_per_<skill>, value per point of the liege's skill (dread, tyranny, martial, stewardship, diplomacy, intrigue, learning, prowess)
fields.knight_limit: knight_limit of the same block (informational: CK3 has max_number_of_knights)
fields.conditional: true when the grant depends on a scripted condition beyond holding the source (culture parameter, government flag, aptitude, grandeur, cohesion, scale, building is_enabled, holy site control/eminence)
fields.trigger: CK3 trigger in liege scope; null = not testable
fields.count: script-value body (liege scope) giving the number of instances for stacking sources (several holdings, artifacts, employees, accolades)
fields.count_condition: extra trigger on the liege for a counted source
fields.scale: scaled grants: value x the scale script value
fields.exclusive_group: records of one group are mutually exclusive by construction (levels)
fields.testable: exact | inferred (trigger follows the docs but an engine detail is unverified) | approx | no
